name: Tacit
detailed_description:
The Great Silencing stole the world’s voice, now only written Letra remained. From the ashes of a fallen empire rose the Swan Song – A legendary tournament where Quills from across the land of Kalimorn battle to prove their mastery of the written word. Victory grants entry to the Liahmis Council, where a single sentence can reshape the future of magic. Enter Tacit, and decide whose words will carry meaning in this silent era!

Overview:

Tacit is a competitive typing-based hero shooter where your words cast spells in real time. Choose from our growing roster of Quills from the four regions of Kalimorn and unleash your mastery of Letra, the living language of magic! Step into the Stadium of Rebirth as a Quill and compete in legendary Swan Songs - high stakes magical combat for the bold and skilled! Participate in fast-paced free-for-all battles where you and your friends compete to become the surviving victor!

Fast Paced Typing Combat:

Enjoy fast paced combat where your typing speed and accuracy determine the victor! Type out your spells to cast then at your opponents. Fight in real time as you compete with up to 4 friends to be the last one standing! 

Quills:
Pick from our roster of unique Quills! Each with their own playstyle, spell set, and regional lore!

Multiplayer Battles:

Fight with your friends or compete against strangers online! Master your typing skills and become a Letra Legend!

Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Ryzen 1700x
  • Memory: 3 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1070
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
